attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any Fortitude check or any check that invokes the Poison or Undead trait.

Discard this card to explore your location.

If you play this card to add dice to your check that has the Poison trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
